necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was medically necessary to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period. This diagnostic monitoring is essential for evaluating the etiology of the palpitations (R42) and ensuring appropriate management of the underlying valvular disease.
